main_text.l: Legis meminit Demosthenes ἐν τῷ Διονυσοδώρου. οἱ νόμοι κελεύουσι τοὺς ναυκλήρους καὶ τοὺς ἐπιβάτας πλεῖν εἰς ὅ,π ἀὶ σιωπῶν ἐμπόριον· Εἰ δὲ μή, τὰς μεγίστας ζημίας [?] εἰσφέρειν [?].

page.notes: Top Greek column is set in capitals with a fragment at its start (ΓΡΟΣ, probably ΠΡΟΣ, cut off); kept as printed. The Latin column beside it is italic. The Greek in the italic and small lines (Demosthenes passages, grammarian's list, final Greek paragraph) is hard to read on this scan; uncertain letters are marked [?] and unreadable stretches are marked as illegible. "a-ftio" is printed this way and is kept as printed. The first Greek word of the main paragraph (ἀτελείας) and the Lacritus reference are doubtful. No marginal notes on this page.
